# The known, justified differences between --ownership=v1 and --ownership=v2,
# in `node bench/ownership-everywhere.mjs --diff=v1,v2` and in the corpus
# harness's v2 parity of every ownership fixture, every run/ program, every
# browser/ page and core (ownership-v2.md §7.2). One per line:
#
#     <root> <module> <line:col> #<k> :: <demand> :: <v1> :: <v2>  <why>
#
# where `#<k>` counts alike demands at one position from 0, and a verdict
# is `accepted`, `rejected`, `pending`, or `absent` when that checker
# reports no such demand: an entry excuses that one difference and no
# other. Both fail on any other difference, and on an entry that no longer
# occurs.
#
# A known limit, a declaration v2 stops at its summary-size limit where the
# fixture is not about limits, is one line too, with its owner:
#
#     <root> <module> limit <declaration>  <owner and why>
#
# v2 accepts where v1 refused.
